title: The invoice email lists the payer's contacts and ticks its Billing contact
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for, with one contact, contact A1, whose email address you can read.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, with two contacts whose email addresses you can read: contact B1, marked Billing, and contact B2, whose first and last names both come before B1's in A to Z order.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced, billed to customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the invoice's email (send) window on the Finance tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The send window lists customer B's contacts, contact B1 and contact B2.
  • Contact B1, marked Billing, is ticked.
  • Contact B2 is not ticked.
  • Contact A1 is not listed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12311 (Story 9, Invoice email to the Bill To)

  • S9-R1: “The send window lists the Bill To's contacts.”
  • S9-R2: “It pre-ticks the Bill To's contact marked Billing, else its first contact A to Z by name.”
  • Feature Overview, Core Bill To: “The Bill To owns the receivable: payment terms and due date, credit limit, Credit Hold, Customer PO and "PO is required", deposits, payments, credits, the QuickBooks invoice customer, IBS, the portal Pay button and the invoice email.”
